name: Waymo Open Dataset
summary: 高质量自动驾驶多传感器数据集，覆盖摄像头、LiDAR、地图、三维检测和运动预测场景，能够支持动态占用、未来轨迹以及闭环驾驶世界表示研究。
license: Waymo Dataset License Agreement; non-commercial restrictions apply
wmNote: 传感器和标注质量突出，适合 3D/4D 感知与运动预测；授权和下载体量需要在项目规划中提前考虑。
summaryEn: A high-quality autonomous-driving collection with cameras, LiDAR, maps, 3D detection labels, and motion scenarios for dynamic occupancy and trajectory prediction.
wmNoteEn: Excellent sensing and annotation support 3D/4D modeling. Licensing constraints and download scale should be considered early.
scaleZh: 2,030 个感知片段 · 10.3 万个运动场景
licenseZh: 适用 Waymo 数据集许可协议；包含非商业限制

evidence.sourceTitle: [1912.04838] Scalability in Perception for Autonomous Driving: Waymo Open Dataset
evidence.statement: Synchronized 20-second driving sequences expose time-indexed observations and road-agent annotations. Static detection labels alone are not the basis.
